record.field: from subscriptiq.services.revenue_calculator import RevenueCalculator metrics = RevenueCalculator.compute_dashboard_metrics(model.env) model.env['subscriptiq.risk.snapshot'].create({ 'company_id': model.env.company.id, 'snapshot_date': model.env['subscriptiq.risk.snapshot'].fields.Date.today(), 'active_subscriptions': metrics['active_subscriptions'], 'mrr': metrics['mrr'], 'arr': metrics['arr'], 'revenue_at_risk': metrics['revenue_at_risk'], 'recovered_revenue': metrics['verified_recovered_revenue'], 'overdue_amount': metrics['outstanding_amount'], 'open_cases': metrics['open_risk_cases_count'], 'leakage_rate': metrics['revenue_leakage_rate'] })
